transcript.statement: Safety is paramount in the RollCall system to protect sensitive attendance data and ensure reliable operation. SAF-01 ensures secure authentication to prevent unauthorized access, while SAF-02 guarantees real-time data synchronization for accurate attendance records. SAF-03 implements automated alerts for discrepancies, enhancing data accuracy. SAF-04 mandates historical data retention for long-term analysis, and SAF-05 provides a logging mechanism for accountability. SAF-06 allows manual overrides during failures, and SAF-07 ensures regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities. These requirements collectively enhance the system's safety and reliability.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication of users to prevent unauthorized access to attendance data.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization to maintain accurate attendance records across multiple classes.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to comply with educational regulations.
The system shall provide a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications to support accountability and traceability.
The system shall allow for manual overrides only in cases of critical failures.
The system shall undergo regular security audits to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
The system shall ensure attendance data is processed in real-time to provide updates within 3 seconds of input.
The system shall support at least 500 concurrent users without performance degradation.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 7 seconds for up to 1000 students.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records with a response time of under 3 seconds.
The system shall implement load balancing to optimize resource utilization across multiple classes and semesters.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds to user interactions within 1 second.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing operations by implementing efficient algorithms.
The system shall support cloud storage solutions that prioritize energy-efficient data centers.
The system shall allow for real-time attendance updates using low-energy communication protocols.
The system shall provide carbon footprint notifications alongside attendance reports.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations such as GDPR when handling student attendance data.
The system shall provide transparency in attendance recording by logging all attendance changes with timestamps and user identification.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 14 days of marking.
The system shall ensure that attendance reports generated for administrators include anonymized data to protect student identities.
The system shall include a feature to notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict attendance data access to authorized personnel only.
The system shall ensure that all student attendance data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
The system shall maintain an audit log of all access and modifications to attendance records.
The system shall provide a mechanism for users to report unauthorized access or data breaches.
The system shall enforce session timeouts to log out users after a period of inactivity.
